subject.title: [Bug]: agents set-identity --workspace does not set the agent's stored workspace, but its success response implies it does

question: Should OpenClaw add a documented CLI workspace-update command for existing agents, or only make `agents set-identity` stop presenting the locator path as `workspace`?
rationale: Both repairs are plausible, but the choice changes public CLI semantics and JSON output compatibility, so automation should not choose the contract unilaterally.

options.title: Add dedicated setter
options.body: Add `agents set-workspace` or `agents update --workspace` backed by `agents.update`, and make `set-identity` output explicit about locator versus stored workspace.

options.title: Clarify output only
options.body: Keep relocation out of the CLI for now and add or rename response fields so `set-identity` cannot be read as confirming a stored workspace update.

options.title: Repurpose set-identity
options.body: Make `set-identity --workspace` update the stored workspace too, accepting compatibility risk against current help text and docs.

recommendation.title: Add dedicated setter
recommendation.body: Add `agents set-workspace` or `agents update --workspace` backed by `agents.update`, and make `set-identity` output explicit about locator versus stored workspace.

likelyOwner.reason: The original identity CLI contract traces to this owner, and the decision is about public CLI shape rather than only the existing Gateway API.
